comment: Gzipped (level 9) size budget per WASM runtime, in bytes, checked by scripts/check-wasm-size.mjs in the web gate. About 5% above each runtime's size when set (2026-10-21); raise one only with a reason in the commit. crypto-calendar is crypto plus calendars and the time zone database (docs/plans/calendar.md), loaded instead of crypto by the apps with calendars.
